title: Online Local Thrift Shop Management System
shortDesc: A full-stack web application automating inventory and sales tracking for small-scale thrift businesses.
longDesc:
Architected a complete inventory and sales tracking platform tailored for local thrift store operations. Key features include:

  • Relational MySQL Database: Manages real-time item status (Available/Sold), category cataloging, and sales receipts.
  • Admin Authentication System: Secure credential handling for stock addition, price edits, and sales ledger management.
  • Dynamic JavaScript Frontend: Instant UI updates upon inventory state transitions across desktop and mobile browsers.
  • Sales Analytics: Instant breakdown of daily revenue and item turnover rates.

title: KDMS - Kenya Disaster Management System
shortDesc: A Gemini-powered FastAPI/React platform for Kenya’s NDMA featuring real-time mapping, AI analysis, and SMS worker dispatch.
longDesc:
A disaster response planning dashboard that blends geospatial awareness, AI analysis, and rapid dispatch orchestration.

  • AI Risk Analysis: Uses Gemini-based recommendations to assess local disaster exposure.
  • Field Communication: SMS and alert flows help coordinate emergency teams.
  • Operational Dashboard: Enables monitoring, data layering, and incident visibility.

title: BimaFast InsurTech Platform
shortDesc: An insurance technology experience for quick quote generation, coverage discovery, and policy management.
longDesc:
BimaFast demonstrates how a complex insurance workflow can become clear, approachable, and responsive for everyday users.

  • Quote Flow: Guides users through coverage choices with clear feedback.
  • Responsive Product UI: Designed for accessible use across mobile and desktop screens.

title: Personal Portfolio Website

longDesc:
